page.overview:
Who is Funny Valentine?

He is the father of Funnier Valentine, and grandfather of The Funniest Valentine as one of the United States' former presidents.

Like his original counterpart, Funny Valentine has long and curly hair, and similar clothes to his original counterpart. He has a few wrinkles and thick eyebrows, due to his age.

Funny Valentine wields the Stand, Singing in the Rain, whose ability is not known, though it appears as a large frog with star-shaped pupils.
